about.title: A Different Rhythm of Living
about.text1: In the hills of Verduno, within the vineyards of Monvigliero, Scarpa Villas offers a rare way to experience Barolo.
about.text2: Inspired by the philosophy of Scarpa, it goes beyond a place to stay – it is shaped by wine, time, and the land itself.
about.text3: Here, days unfold slowly, between the silence of the vines, the warmth of the sun, and the rituals of Piedmontese life.

experience.paragraph1: Scarpa Villas were created as a natural extension of the Scarpa winery — a place where the philosophy of wine can be lived, not only tasted.
experience.paragraph2: Founded in 1900, Scarpa has always believed that great wine is shaped by time, patience, and a deep connection to the land.
experience.paragraph3: The villas bring guests closer to that philosophy through the vineyards of Monvigliero, the culture of Barolo, and experiences rooted in the traditions of Piedmont.

storyVillasCTA.text: Scarpa Villas bring this story to life — offering a way to experience Barolo through space, time, and connection to the land.

originsIntro.titleLine1: In the hills of the Langhe,
originsIntro.titleLine2: time is not measured in years,
originsIntro.textLine1: What exists today is the result of centuries of quiet transformation —
originsIntro.textLine2: a landscape shaped slowly, almost imperceptibly, over time.

originsHistory.topText: Long before Barolo became one of the world's most celebrated wine regions, these hills were already inhabited and cultivated.
originsHistory.bottomText: Over centuries, the Langhe evolved through layered histories — from prehistoric settlement and early agriculture in Piedmont to the Roman presence that further shaped the region through roads, farming, and viticulture.

originsMedieval.titleLine1: In the Middle Ages, the villages that define the
originsMedieval.titleLine2: region today began to take form, and the vineyard
originsMedieval.titleLine3: landscape continued to develop into what we now
originsMedieval.text: What you see today is not a place that was created at once, but one shaped over time — by generations who lived, worked, and cultivated this land.

originsMonvigliero.text1: Located above the village of Verduno, on the northern edge of the Barolo appellation, these vineyards have long been known for their distinctive character — refined, expressive, and deeply connected to the identity of the region.
originsMonvigliero.text2Bold: one of the most distinctive crus of Barolo
originsMonvigliero.text2End: , shaped by its altitude, exposure, and the quiet balance between sun and air that defines these hills.
originsMonvigliero.text3End: grow side by side, continuing a tradition that reflects both the depth and the quiet elegance of this place.

originsCTA.title: SCARPA VILLAS CONTINUE THIS STORY
originsCTA.textLine1: CONTEMPORARY IN COMFORT, YET ROOTED IN A LANDSCAPE
originsCTA.textLine2: THAT HAS EVOLVED OVER CENTURIES, THEY OFFER A WAY TO EXPERIENCE BAROLO
originsCTA.textLine3: NOT AS A VISITOR, BUT AS PART OF ITS ONGOING RHYTHM.

scarpaWineryIntro.title:
For over a century, Scarpa has been sharing wines
that reflect time, place, and patience
scarpaWineryIntro.textLine1: Rooted in Piedmont, its philosophy goes beyond production —
scarpaWineryIntro.textLine2: it is a way of understanding wine.

scarpaWineryLove.title: Wine For Love
scarpaWineryLove.paragraph1: Scarpa was founded in 1900 by Antonio Scarpa, who moved from Venice to Nizza Monferrato in search of opportunity — and found something more.
scarpaWineryLove.paragraph2: Two connections made him stay: the untapped potential of the land, and his love for Ernestina Ottavia Deantonio, who became his wife in 1908.
scarpaWineryLove.paragraph3: Together, they built a winery with a clear ambition — to reveal the true potential of Piedmontese wines, starting with Barbera, at a time when it was still underestimated.

scarpaWineryEvolution.title: Evolution
scarpaWineryEvolution.leftText: Over the decades, Scarpa evolved through a succession of visionaries — from Antonio Scarpa to Mario Pesce, Carlo Castino, and Silvio Pinchera.
scarpaWineryEvolution.rightText: Each brought a deeper understanding of the land, refining a style built on elegance, longevity, and respect for the vineyard.

scarpaWineryProcess.title: Time, Purity, And Patience
scarpaWineryProcess.paragraph1: Scarpa wines are not forced — they are allowed to evolve.
scarpaWineryProcess.paragraph2: Long aging, minimal intervention, and a deep respect for native grape varieties define a style rooted in purity and expression.
scarpaWineryProcess.paragraph3: Each decision, from vineyard to cellar, is guided by a simple belief: great wine reveals itself over time.

scarpaWineryVineyards.title: Vineyards
scarpaWineryVineyards.paragraph1: Scarpa cultivates vineyards across Monferrato and Langhe, combining historic estates with carefully selected crus.
scarpaWineryVineyards.paragraph2: From the single-body vineyard of Poderi Bricchi to the hills of Barolo and Barbaresco — including Monvigliero in Verduno — each site contributes to a broader understanding of Piedmont's identity.

scarpaWineryCellar.title: Cellar
scarpaWineryCellar.paragraph1: In the historic cellars of Nizza Monferrato, wine follows its own rhythm.
scarpaWineryCellar.paragraph2: Large barrels, long aging, and time itself shape wines designed not only for the present, but for decades to come.

scarpaWineryVillas.title: Villas
scarpaWineryVillas.paragraph1: Scarpa Villas extend this philosophy beyond the glass.
scarpaWineryVillas.paragraph2: Set among the vineyards, they offer a way to experience the same values — time, space, and connection to the land — through living, not just tasting.
